AgentArtifact.description: One artifact produced by an adapter target.

path.description: Path relative to the artifact root supplied in `RuntimeContext`.

AgentModelUsage.description:
Usage of one model within one invocation.

Token fields have the same meaning as the matching `AgentUsage` fields,
restricted to requests served by this model.

cache_write_input_tokens.description: Input tokens this model wrote to the provider prompt cache, when reported.

cached_input_tokens.description: Cached input tokens consumed by this model, when reported.

cost_usd.description: Cost in US dollars for this model when reported by the provider.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens consumed by this model.

input_tokens_include_cache.description:
Whether input_tokens already includes both cached_input_tokens (cache
reads) and cache_write_input_tokens (cache writes); absent means
unknown. True means both are included and false means both are
excluded. When the provider includes only one of the two, the adapter
normalizes input_tokens to one of these states before reporting.

model.description: Model identifier as reported by the harness or provider response.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens produced by this model.

output_tokens_include_reasoning.description: Whether output_tokens already includes reasoning_tokens; absent means unknown.

peak_request_input_tokens.description:
Input tokens of the largest single request served by this model,
including cached and cache-write input, when reported.

provider.description: Provider or route that served the model, when known.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens produced by this model, when reported.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens reported by the provider for this model.

AgentRunError.description: Error reported by an adapter target.

retryable.description: Whether the adapter considers the failure safe for a consumer-level retry.

AgentRunStatus.description: Completion status reported by an adapter target.

oneOf.description: The adapter target completed with a failure.
